title: Pfosten
description: Simple mod that adds log posts :3
body:
Just a simple mod that adds log posts for all the different vanilla wood types

Pfosten is german for Posts (and it also doubles as an insult lol)

![Image featuring all the different log posts](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4c702181bad5b1f56305afea05dccb18e727f106.jpeg)

They're also waterloggable!
![Waterlogged posts](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/416c82b11069cc9eff14bbb027e2a51b8653997c.jpeg)

You can give me feedback (Issues or Feature requests) on my github!
